newsitem.title: DENMARK: Phoenix declines to recommend bidder.
newsitem.headline: Phoenix declines to recommend bidder.

text.p: Danish triple bid target Phoenix Constructors on Friday declined to recommend a favoured suitor, saying that it would first hold talks with the two highest bidders, Norway's Rieber and Son and Denmark's Superfos.

Following a shareholders' meeting and subsequent board session the roadbuilder said that shareholders were divided on which offer to accept and the bidding war between Rieber and Superfos was hampering a decision.
"With a view to shortening this process the board will contact the bidders to seek a resolution," a statement said.
"In order to ensure that a sale can be completed, the board will only make a recommendation when it is sure that there is an offer upon which shareholders can agree," it added.
Rieber started the day as the highest bidder, offering a total of 802 million Danish crowns for Phoenix, but Superfos then raised the ante to 808 million.

The Norwegians then came back with a counterbid of 740 crowns per A-share and 655 crowns per C-share, totalling 820 million crowns. The most-traded C-share's price on the Copenhagen bourse closed at 670, up from Thursday's 665.
